title: [cpprestsdk] DLLs do not have the App Container bit set

labels.name: category:vcpkg-bug
labels.description: The issue is with the vcpkg system (including helper scripts in `scripts/cmake/`)

body: I have this error when run this command: C:\Users\MYUSER\Desktop\Sources\vcpkg>.\toolsrc\Release\vcpkg.exe install cpprestsdk:x86-uwp zlib:x64-windows -- CURRENT_INSTALLED_DIR=C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/installed/x86-uwp -- DOWNLOADS=C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/downloads -- CURRENT_PACKAGES_DIR=C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/packages/cpprestsdk_x86-uwp -- CURRENT_BUILDTREES_DIR=C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/buildtrees/cpprestsdk -- CURRENT_PORT_DIR=C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/ports/cpprestsdk/. -- Cloning -- Cloning done -- Adding worktree and patching -- Patching -- Adding worktree and patching done -- Configuring x86-uwp-rel -- Configuring x86-uwp-rel done -- Configuring x86-uwp-dbg -- Configuring x86-uwp-dbg done -- Build x86-uwp-rel -- Build x86-uwp-rel done -- Build x86-uwp-dbg -- Build x86-uwp-dbg done -- Package x86-uwp-rel -- Package x86-uwp-rel done -- Package x86-uwp-dbg -- Package x86-uwp-dbg done -- Warning: Could not find a matching pdb file for: C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/packages/cpprestsdk_x86-uwp/bin/cpprest_2_8.dll -- Performing post-build validation The following DLLs do not have the App Container bit set: ``` C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/packages/cpprestsdk_x86-uwp/bin/cpprest_2_8.dll C:/Users/MYUSER/Desktop/Sources/vcpkg/packages/cpprestsdk_x86-uwp/debug/bin/cpprest_2_8.dll ``` This bit is required for Windows Store apps. Found 1 error(s). Please correct the portfile: C:\Users\MYUSER\Desktop\Sources\vcpkg\ports\cpprestsdk\portfile.cmake My vcpkg version is: Vcpkg package management program version 0.0.30-e507c14229e5dd206499eef3ffa4e887131b9678
